name: analyze_web_bundle
description: Capture JavaScript source from one selected CDP page and statically derive a chunk graph, route and endpoint candidates, vendor fingerprints, page-declared WebMCP metadata, and optionally fetch source maps from the selected target origin or explicitly requested origins. JavaScript is parsed but never executed.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Maximum startup, analysis and result transfer time per captured script, in milliseconds; defaults to 30000. Timed-out scripts are explicit unknowns and other scripts may still be analyzed.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback CDP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:PORT, or ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/devtools/browser/ID.

include_accessibility_text.description: Whether to include accessibility text in the result.

include_console_text.description: Whether to include console text in the result.

include_json_body_shapes.description: Whether to include json body shapes in the result.

include_script_sources.description: Whether to include script sources in the result.

include_storage_fingerprints.description: Whether to include storage fingerprints in the result.

include_storage_keys.description: Whether to include storage keys in the result.

include_websocket_shapes.description: Whether to include websocket shapes in the result.

max_heap_mb.description: Maximum V8 old-space heap in MiB for the isolated inert-script analyzer; defaults to 1024. This is not a total process RSS limit. Bun ignores V8 flags; Windows Bun uses an owned process commit limit plus a 512 MiB runtime reserve, while other Bun hosts have no enforced memory limit.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

total_analysis_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time for all captured-script analysis, in milliseconds; defaults to 300000. Capture and optional source-map fetching have separate budgets. Unstarted scripts remain explicit unknowns.
